semantic_review: Durable authentication_issuance preserves issued/pending/completed/active/revoked metadata after ciphertext take. A child session requires same-namespace still-pending unexpired parent; unique parent index and writer serialization prevent duplicate children.

Unknown syntactic login/session handles cause no durable row, pending-map entry or write admission. Known logout places its immediate bounded local fence before awaiting the existing writer queue; 204 follows durable success, 503 does not claim persistence.

CR72-01 is repaired: failed writer admission/commit clears only the in-flight promise, retaining the fixed-horizon fence for local authorization and permitting retry. Success removes the fence after durable commit; crash after503 is explicitly outside durable proof.

Managed issuance shares persisted capacity across stores:4096 logical records,512 issued/pending challenges,32MiB payloads,64KiB each; tighter initial policy persists and divergent reopening fails. Refusal preserves current live credentials. Refresh preserves exact absolute deadline and subject and cannot recreate missing/revoked state.

Collector uses expiry indexes and one aggregate128-row deletion budget; consumed parent retention reaches challenge expiry+8h and is never shortened to a peer's shorter session duration. Payload-first bounded collection does not evict valid state.

Authentication reads use a fresh synchronous SELECT connection with lifecycle and inherited scope checks, not the older business snapshot. The connection is not opened with a database readonly flag; the supplied read work performs no mutations. Writes remain in existing operation(true) and poison nested readonly attempts.

Readonly59 still owns BEGIN IMMEDIATE. A second writer cannot commit while that root holds the SQLite writer. The proposed composed test starts logout outside root AsyncLocalStorage, releases Graph/root, then waits for durable logout; nested collect rejection contaminates the root even when caught.

Entry starts auth maintenance after successful configured composition or in the unconfigured branch, independent of operator backup jobs and HTTP traffic. Dispose stops/drains auth maintenance before jobs/store. Existing generic local/operator adapters retain their signatures; Microsoft creation requires the durable authentication capability.
PKCE, nonce, AES-256-GCM, storage-key AAD, opaque cookies, tenant/client/origin/mount/key binding, subject checks, absolute session expiration and fresh post-Graph revocation checks preserved.

Current runtime/application consumer authenticates in the business transaction; 73 adds visibility guards without changing that call boundary. Entry and CLI adapters still load installed canonical code and preserve configured ingress and privacy controls. This review does not convert those static paths into installed proof.
